core_obligations: Object-surjective case: MS2 + MS6 exhibit objects of S^-1D as filtered colimits; TR2 rotation reduces the general case to it.
Saturation plus what-gets-inverted gives fullness on arrows; the X/S filtered-colimit equality trick and the S^-1D commutativity replacement trick are displayed in full.
The three filtered conditions and both cofinality conditions are checked one by one.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the object case via TR2; build the filtered system from MS2/MS6 colimits.
Close fullness via saturation and what-gets-inverted; verify cofinality with the two displayed tricks.
difficulty_reason: The filtered-colimit equality trick and the commutativity replacement are genuine displayed content; no omissions.
